name: bloodhound-ce-python
summary: Python data collector for Bloodhound community edition (v5)
highlights: -c — Which information to collect. Supported: Group, LocalAdmin, Session, Trusts, Default (all
-u — Username. Format: username[@domain]; If the domain is unspecified, the current domain is u
--auth-method — Authentication methods. Force Kerberos or NTLM only or use auto for Kerberos with NTLM fal

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --collectionmethod
flags.description: Which information to collect. Supported: Group, LocalAdmin, Session, Trusts, Default (all previous), DCOnly (no computer connections), DCOM, RDP,PSRemote, LoggedOn, Container, ObjectProps, ACL, All (all except LoggedOn). You can specify more than one by separating them with a comma. (default: Default)

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: Domain to query.

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Enable verbose output

flags.name: --username
flags.description: Username. Format: username[@domain]; If the domain is unspecified, the current domain is used.

flags.name: --password
flags.description: Password

flags.name: --kerberos
flags.description: Use kerberos ccache file

flags.name: --hashes
flags.description: LM:NLTM hashes

flags.name: -no-pass
flags.description: don't ask for password (useful for -k)

flags.name: --auth-method
flags.description: Authentication methods. Force Kerberos or NTLM only or use auto for Kerberos with NTLM fallback

flags.name: --nameserver
flags.description: Alternative name server to use for queries

flags.name: --dns-tcp
flags.description: Use TCP instead of UDP for DNS queries

flags.name: --dns-timeout
flags.description: DNS query timeout in seconds (default: 3)

flags.name: --domain-controller
flags.description: Override which DC to query (hostname)

flags.name: --global-catalog
flags.description: Override which GC to query (hostname)

flags.name: --workers
flags.description: Number of workers for computer enumeration (default: 10)

flags.name: --exclude-dcs
flags.description: Skip DCs during computer enumeration

flags.name: --disable-pooling
flags.description: Don't use subprocesses for ACL parsing (only for debugging purposes)

flags.name: --disable-autogc
flags.description: Don't automatically select a Global Catalog (use only if it gives errors)

flags.name: --zip
flags.description: Compress the JSON output files into a zip archive

flags.name: --computerfile
flags.description: File containing computer FQDNs to use as allowlist for any computer based methods

flags.name: --cachefile
flags.description: Cache file (experimental)

flags.name: --ldap-channel-binding
flags.description: Use LDAP Channel Binding (will force ldaps protocol to be used)

flags.name: --use-ldaps
flags.description: Use LDAP over TLS on port 636 by default

flags.name: --outputprefix
flags.description: String to prepend to output file names
